name: ausspend
description: Australian government spending explorer — Phase 1 monorepo foundation

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && vitest run
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.seed: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/seed.ts
scripts.seed:real: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/seed.ts --no-synthetic
scripts.seed:synthetic: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/seed.ts --synthetic
scripts.clean:synthetic: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/clean-synthetic.ts
scripts.ingest:federal: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/ingest-federal.ts
scripts.ingest:nsw: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/ingest-nsw.ts
scripts.ingest:phase4: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/ingest-phase4.ts
scripts.ingest:qld: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/ingest-qld.ts
scripts.archive:vic: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/vic-source-archive.ts
scripts.grantconnect:chunks: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/grantconnect-chunks.ts
scripts.archive:nsw: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/nsw-source-archive.ts
scripts.archive: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/source-archive.ts
scripts.pdf:extract: npm run build -w shared && tsx scripts/pdf-extract.ts
